system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in a tweed suit, leaning over a small saucer of milk set on top of an iron safe","action":"Holmes lifts the saucer to inspect it while Watson stands at his shoulder and Helen Stoner waits near the doorway, watching quietly","setting":"Dr. Roylott's plainly furnished bedroom: camp-bed, wooden shelf of books, armchair, plain wooden chair, round table and large iron safe","secondaryElements":"Shelf of technical books, a camp-bed with plain covers, a dark-clad Miss Stoner by the door, the faint outline of the saucer on the safe's top","mood":"Quiet, intent and faintly uneasy, with restrained suspense and dry detective concentration","timeOfDay":"Late morning","composition":"Medium-wide interior view from the doorway, Holmes and the safe in the foreground-left, Watson and Miss Stoner receding to the right, the room's furniture arranged around them"}
